descriptions.coop:together: Complete your first zone with at least one other player.
descriptions.coop:odds: Complete any zone with at least one other player, with all four enemy difficulty modifiers at maximum.
descriptions.coop:bump: Complete Duskwood with at least one other player, without any player dying.
descriptions.coop:team: Complete Warsong Gulch and Arathi Basin, each with at least one other player.
descriptions.coop:dragonslayers: Defeat Azuregos and Nefarian, each with at least one other player.
descriptions.coop:oldgods: Defeat C'Thun with at least one other player, with all four enemy difficulty modifiers at maximum.
descriptions.coop:end: Complete all 12 zones, each with at least one other player, across any number of runs.
